title: European Region Peril Codes (v2.8)
text:
European Region Peril Codes (v2.8)
 

Peril codes for the European region supported by 
UNICEDE
/2 supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PWS | Windstorm only |
| PEQ | Earthquake only |
| PFL | Flood Only |
| PAN | Pandemic |

Note:

The countries in the European region where each of these perils is
 currently modeled by 
Verisk

Austria, Belgium, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France,
 Germany, Hungary, the Republic of Ireland, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania,
 Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, Switzerland,
 United Kingdom

 Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, the Republic of Ireland, Israel,
 Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Netherlands, Norway, Poland,
